content.guideline: This document discusses various clinical studies and guidelines related to cardiovascular conditions such as catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia, Brugada syndrome, and early repolarization patterns. It includes management strategies, risk stratification, and genetic testing approaches for these conditions.

genes.context: A mutation in CALM1 encoding calmodulin in familial idiopathic ventricular fibrillation in childhood and adolescence.
Calcium channel mutations in calmodulin cause ventricular tachycardia and sudden cardiac death.
SCN5A mutations in the study identified Brugada syndrome cases.
Analysis of KCNQ1 gene in relation to cardiac arrhythmias.
